quotes.text: Truth is the highest virtue, but higher still is truthful living.
quotes.author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji

quotes.text: In the ambrosial hours of the early morning, meditate and contemplate the True Name.
quotes.author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji

quotes.text: One who serves becomes one with the Lord.
quotes.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji

quotes.text: Within the heart, the Name of the Lord abides.
quotes.author: Guru Amar Das Ji

quotes.text: Even Kings and emperors with mountains of property and oceans of wealth are not equal to an ant filled with the love of God.
quotes.author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji
